description:
What Application Development & Maintenance contributes to Cardinal Health 
  
 Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.
  
 Application Development & Maintenance performs configuration or coding to develop, enhance and sustain the organization's software systems in a cross-functional team environment through adherence to established design control processes and good engineering practices. This job family programs and configures end user applications, systems, databases and websites to achieve the organization's internal needs and externally-facing business needs. Application Development & Maintenance partners with business leaders, investigates user needs and conducts regular assessments, maintenance and enhancements of existing applications.
  
 The AIMS Consultant in the COE Operations Technology organization provides support to our distribution centers by aligning process and technology to optimize the value of the AIMS warehouse management system and supporting technologies for the Cardinal Health Medical Supply Chain. 
  
 Responsibilities 
 Provide guidance and support for the functional use of AIMS, and supporting technologies via the phone, email, IM or on-site.
 Develop documentation and deliver training on new and existing system features to new or existing hourly associates and supervisors/managers.
 Analyze supply chain processes and make recommendations for new system capabilities.
 Prepare clear and concise requirement documents / functional specification designs for new features and review / approve technical specification documents.
 Communicate effectively with various functional groups and external customers.
 Create and execute test scripts to ensure proper system function for new and existing features.
 Provide support for new system implementations.
  
 Qualifications 
 4-8 years of experience within supply chain operations, warehouse management systems, or associated technologies, preferred
 Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred
 Experience with warehouse management systems and installation
 Experience with AIMS, the Cardinal Health Medical warehouse system, a plus
 Functional understanding or exposure to Parcel Systems, Electronic Signature Capture, AS/RS Technology, RFID, Drug Pedigree Management, Transportation Management, Dock Management or Labor Management
 Comprehend business process at all steps in the supply chain
 Detail oriented individual with good oral and presentation skills
 Detail oriented with the ability to work independently
 Must be able to convey ideas effectively, verbally and through written communication, to all levels of management
 Comprehend business process at all steps in the supply chain, not only within the distribution center
 Ability to travel as needed
  
 What is expected of you and others at this level 
 Applies comprehensive knowledge and a thorough understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks and projects
 May contribute to the development of policies and procedures
 Works on complex projects of large scope
 Develops technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems
 Solutions are innovative and consistent with organization objectives
 Completes work; independently receives general guidance on new projects
 Work reviewed for purpose of meeting objectives
 May act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues
 
 Anticipated salary range: $96,300 - $137,600 
 Bonus eligible: No 
 Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being. 
 Medical, dental and vision coverage 
 Paid time off plan 
 Health savings account (HSA) 
 401k savings plan 
 Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay 
 Flexible spending accounts (FSAs) 
 Short- and long-term disability coverage 
 Work-Life resources 
 Paid parental leave 
 Healthy lifestyle programs 
 
 Application window anticipated to close: 12/09/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible. 

 The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.
